name: Portkey
scope_notes: Covers Portkey (Prisma AIRS AI Gateway). SaaS control plane with hybrid/air-gapped self-hosted options; JWT auth, audit logs and key-permission settings are Enterprise, rotation is on all plans.

controls.name: API key scopes
controls.what: Each key gets a list of permission scopes at create/update.

controls.name: expires_at / org-workspace maximum TTL
controls.what: Key expiry date, which cannot exceed a configured org/workspace maximum TTL.
controls.setting: expires_at on create; max TTL setting name not documented

controls.name: Rotation policy
controls.what: Scheduled automatic rotation (weekly, monthly or N days).

controls.name: user_api_key_rotation_period
controls.what: Org enforces a rotation cadence (1-365 days) on workspace-user keys.

controls.name: API Key Management permissions
controls.what: Controls whether workspace managers/members can view or manage keys.
controls.setting: Admin Settings > Security > API Key Management

controls.name: Per-key rate and usage limits
controls.what: Request/token rate limits and cost/token budgets per key.

controls.name: Pinned default config
controls.what: Pins a config to a key; allow_config_override=false stops callers overriding it.

controls.name: JWKS configuration
controls.what: Only JWTs signed by configured JWKS are accepted; remove JWKS to stop JWT auth.

controls.name: Integration workspace provisioning
controls.what: Choose which workspaces and models can use stored provider credentials.

controls.name: Manage Keys (Workspace Managers)
controls.what: Org admins can turn off workspace managers' ability to create, update and delete workspace service and user API keys.
controls.setting: Admin Settings > Security > API Key Management

controls.name: Manage Keys (Workspace Members)
controls.what: Org admins can turn off workspace members' ability to create, update and delete their own user API keys.
controls.setting: Admin Settings > Security > API Key Management

controls.name: Managers Write Workspace Integrations
controls.what: Org admins can stop workspace managers from creating, updating or deleting AI integrations; owners and admins keep full access.
controls.setting: Admin Settings > Security > Integration Management (workspace-level overrides possible)

controls_unknown: IP allowlisting for API keys or JWTs
Name of the org/workspace maximum key TTL setting
Whether user API keys are disabled when the user is removed or deprovisioned via SCIM
Whether SSO enforcement affects API keys
Whether GET (read) API calls appear in audit logs (filter lists only POST/PUT/DELETE)
Auth cache delay after key deletion

authentication.summary: Org-level keys sent in x-portkey-api-key. They can act across all workspaces and manage users, workspaces, keys, integrations and audit logs depending on scopes.

federation.details: Static key. SSO (OIDC/SAML) is documented for control-plane login only; no statement that keys follow IdP policy.

ip_restriction.boundary: No IP allowlist for API keys found in docs. Audit logs record client IP.

lifetime.summary: Optional expires_at, capped by org/workspace max TTL if configured

renewal.summary: POST /v2/api-keys/{id}/rotate or scheduled rotation; old secret valid for transition period (min 30 min).

administration.summary: Only org owners/admins can create and manage. Scopes set at create/update.

inventory.details: Admin API GET /api-keys lists keys; admin keys can carry the organisation_service_api_keys.list scope.

reads.ui: Admin Settings > Audit Logs > filter Action = Export

log_sources.name: Audit Logs
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; Admin Settings > Audit Logs or GET /audit-logs (admin key with audit_logs.list); indefinite retention; filter by user_type=api_key.

log_sources.name: Request Logs
log_sources.notes: Gateway request logs with full request/response; retention 3 days Developer, 30 days Production, unlimited Enterprise.

containment.steps: DELETE the key via Admin API or dashboard; or rotate with minimum 30-minute transition.
containment.notes: Rotation leaves old secret valid at least 30 minutes.

authentication.summary: Clients send an RS256 JWT instead of an API key; Portkey validates it against JWKS configured on the organisation. Claims carry org, workspace and scopes.

federation.details: Any issuer whose JWKS URL/JSON is configured; user identified from email_id, sub or uid.

lifetime.summary: exp claim required; set by issuer

administration.summary: Configured under Admin Settings > Organisation > Authentication.

reads.ui: Admin Settings > Audit Logs > filter Action = Export

expiry.ui: Set by the issuer via the JWT exp claim (mandatory); check exp in the token payload

kill.ui: Admin Settings > Organisation > Authentication > remove the key (kid) from JWKS URL/JWKS JSON; then revoke at the issuer
